snippet.title: Knuckles Quest SAGE 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Knuckles Quest will be returning to Sonic Amateur Games Expo 2025 with a new demo! This trailer goes over the features that have been added over the past year, including some that have just newly been released!

PLAY THE GAME:
https://iggyminious.itch.io/knuckles-quest-demo
https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/knuckles-quest-sage-2025-demo.2701/

Music:
The Dreamy Stage...for Casinopolis
Mt. Red: a Symbol of Thrill...for Red Mountain
